CONNECT.CHECKING_THAT_THIS_ENVIRONMENT_I: Checking that this environment is ready. This can take a minute after project creation.
CONNECT.CHECK_YOUR_CONNECTION_THEN_TRY: Check your connection, then try again.
CONNECT.CHOOSE_AN_ENVIRONMENT_FOR_TO: Choose an environment for {{name}} to continue.
CONNECT.CHOOSE_THE_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT_A: Choose the project, environment, and access this application can use.
CONNECT.COULD_NOT_CANCEL_THE_CONNECTION: Could not cancel the connection request.
CONNECT.CREATE_A_PROJECT_TO_CONTINUE: Create a project to continue connecting your site.
CONNECT.GO_BACK_TO_YOUR_SITE: Go back to your site and click Connect again.
CONNECT.SELECT_AT_LEAST_ONE_EACH: Select at least one. Each chip shows the matching Git branch.
CONNECT.SELECT_A_PROJECT_TO_SEE: Select a project to see its environments.
CONNECT.SELECT_THE_ENVIRONMENT_THIS: Select the environment this application can access.
CONNECT.SELECT_THE_LEVEL_OF_LOCALIZATION: Select the level of localization access to grant in {{environment}}.
CONNECT.SOMEONE_ELSE_IS_ALREADY_HANDLING: Someone else is already handling this connection request. Go back to your site and start again if you want to connect it for yourself.
CONNECT.THE_NEW_PROJECT_WILL_APPEAR: The new project will appear here when its environments are available.
CONNECT.THIS_CONNECTION_REQUEST_IS_IN: This connection request is in use
CONNECT.THIS_ENVIRONMENT_IS_TAKING_LONGE: This environment is taking longer to set up
CONNECT.THIS_PAGE_IS_MISSING_ITS: This page is missing its connection details. Go back to your site and click Connect again.
CONNECT.WE_COULD_NOT_READ_THIS: We could not read this connection request. Go back to your site and click Connect again.
CONNECT.WE_COULD_NOT_START_THE: We could not start the connection request. Go back to your site and click Connect again.
CONNECT.YOUR_SITE_IS_CONNECTED_TO: Your site is connected to Blocks OS.
CONNECT.YOU_DON_T_HAVE_A: You don't have a project yet
CONNECT.YOU_DON_T_HAVE_PERMISSION: You don't have permission to set up integrations in this environment. Choose another environment or ask an administrator for access.
